author: Google
description:
Google Flow Agent is your creative partner that can plan and reason through complex tasks with your inputs, under your control. Built with Gemini models, it brings expertise and a deep understanding of your project to help with early brainstorming, creating and editing. For example, your agent can be a sounding board for dialogue between characters in a specific scene, or even make plot recommendations. 

00:00 Introduction to Google Flow
00:32 Activating the Creative Agent
00:59 Prompting Variations & Character Adherence
01:26 Editing Assets & Organizing Collections with Gemini Omni

The agent is available to all Google Flow users globally.
